backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing homepage content, user profiles, and generation history with access control enforcement.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing profile-editing related frontend files and associated components, tests, and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI, generation tools, and profile management.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind styles defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the React application and mounting the app in the #root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes, layout, theming, and global providers.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog component allowing authenticated users to view and update their display name using existing profile APIs.
frontend/src/components/GeneratedAssetCa: Reusable card for displaying generated media with loading state overlay and optional download button.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Onboarding dialog prompting new authenticated users to enter and save their name before using the app.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Shows a sign-in card when no Internet Identity is present and otherwise renders children.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, year, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Displays the site header with navigation, branding, user menu, and admin-aware links.
frontend/src/components/ToolCard.tsx: A reusable card linking to a tool page with icon, title, description, and CTA button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Fetches whether the current caller is an admin using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useHomepageContent.ts: Provides queries and mutations for reading and updating homepage content via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, status tracking, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides user profile, generation history, and related CRUD hooks backed by the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theming variables, dark mode styles, and font imports.
frontend/src/lib/clientImageGen.ts: Generates deterministic abstract images from a prompt using canvas with seeded randomness.
frontend/src/lib/clientVideoGen.ts: Creates a deterministic particle animation on a canvas and records it into a WebM video based on a text prompt.
frontend/src/lib/historyAssetStore.ts: Implements IndexedDB helpers to store and retrieve binary assets using generated unique IDs.
frontend/src/lib/homepageDefaults.ts: Defines default homepage and branding content and provides a function to merge backend data with these defaults.
frontend/src/lib/voiceover.ts: Provides a controller for text‑to‑speech playback with start, stop, pause, and resume handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminHomeEditor.tsx: Admin UI allowing authenticated admins to edit homepage content with form inputs and backend updates.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Renders the homepage using merged branding/content and showcases available AI tools.
frontend/src/pages/MyHistory.tsx: Displays the user’s generation history with preview, re‑edit, and delete actions using stored assets.
frontend/src/pages/TextToImage.tsx: Provides a text‑to‑image generator UI that saves generated images to history and supports re‑editing.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVideo.tsx: UI page for generating videos from text prompts, handling video creation, history saving, and re-editing based on URL params. Manages prompt input, generation state, download, and authenticated record updates.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVoiceover.tsx: UI page for generating voiceovers from text using Web Speech API, including playback controls, voice selection, and history saving or re-editing via URL params. Manages synthesis state and updates generation records when authenticated.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback. Supports both query-string and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and plugin usage. Sets up global design tokens and responsive container settings.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing existing features, requirements, and versioning for a user profile editing feature. Contains no functional code.
